umbilicus.method: midline deepest vertex of named umbilical region; anterior projection

xiphoidTip.method: inferior-most xiphoid vertex; anterior midline projection

pubicUpper.method: superior edge of named joint; anterior midline projection

sternalNotch.method: upper border within central 4 mm band; candidate suprasternal notch

nippleL.method: largest local anterior relief relative to a fitted 8–24 mm annular plane; nipple candidate requiring expert review

nippleR.method: largest local anterior relief relative to a fitted 8–24 mm annular plane; nipple candidate requiring expert review

elbow.method: distal humeral band center approximates elbow crease level

wrist.method: distal radioulnar band center approximates wrist crease level

axilla.method: 88% humeral axis is candidate axillary crease level, not observed crease

medialAnkle.method: lowest tibial vertex as medial malleolus tip candidate

lateralAnkle.method: lowest fibular vertex as lateral malleolus tip candidate

ASIS.method: anterior superior iliac region heuristic, not adjudicated ASIS

sacralHiatus.method: lower14% of sacral height, approximate hiatus not foramen segmentation

anteriorHairline.method: synthetic hairline: inferred forehead3cun, not observed hairline

posteriorHairline.method: inferior occipital surface-region height plus8mm; synthetic, not observed hairline; no reuse of forehead cun for nape

limitations: All362 are engineering candidates. Standards text is not proof of spatial accuracy.
Existing92 retain prior arc/intercostal/vertebral rules; new270 use explicit local anatomy seeds and linear segment projection, with code-specific heuristics.
Synthetic hairlines, inferred creases, sacral-foramen strata, tendon borders and anatomical offsets require human review.
GV28 is an external-lip proxy because suitable frenulum/gingival mucosa is not represented. It MUST NOT be described as the real point.
There are no needle depths or needle-direction vectors; normals are for display only.
No clinical accuracy statistic has been measured. Bone-cun labels express the engineering rule, not individual clinical measurement.

catalogue.name: 中府
catalogue.location: 在前胸部,横平第1肋间隙,锁骨下窝外侧,前正中线旁开6寸。
catalogue.notes: 注1:先确定云门(LU2),中府即在云门(LU2)下1寸。注2:横平内侧的库房(ST14)、彧中(KI26)、华盖(CV20),4穴略呈一弧形分布,其弧度与第1肋间隙弧度相应。

catalogue.name: 云门
catalogue.location: 在前胸部,锁骨下窝凹陷中,肩胛骨喙突内缘,前正中线旁开6寸。
catalogue.notes: 注:横平内侧的气户(ST13)、俞府(KI27)、璇玑(CV21),4穴略呈一弧形分布,其弧度与锁骨下缘弧度相应。

catalogue.name: 天府
catalogue.location: 在臂前外侧,腋前纹头下3寸,肱二头肌桡侧缘处。
catalogue.notes: 注:肱二头肌外侧沟平腋前纹头处至尺泽(LU5)连线的上1/3与下2/3的交界处。
dependencies: 当前姿态下皮肤横纹端点
肌腱边缘及体位约束

catalogue.name: 侠白

catalogue.name: 尺泽
